commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
She goes on, to her friend.

The cowherd’s flute, once sweet, has become the messenger of evening, which now burns like fire, and the weapon that kills me when evening comes. It is a messenger because it announces evening in advance, and a weapon because it is the means of killing. If evening can burn by itself, what won’t it do with all this help?
